answer:
Your records show two medicines as active right now:

1. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once a day. This is a cholesterol medicine. It was prescribed on 20 February 2025.

2. Jardiance 10 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once a day in the morning. This is for diabetes. It was prescribed on 20 February 2025.

Metformin 500 mg was your diabetes medicine until it ended on 15 April 2024, and the records show it as completed. Your records have no other active medicines. The records run to mid-October 2026, so check with your pharmacy or doctor that this list is still right, since a change after that would not show here. The records do not show when you actually started taking either medicine, only when they were prescribed.
